--------
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
------
For the Petitioner : Mr. R.S. Mazumdar, Sr. Advocate.
 : Mr. Santosh Kumar, Advocate.
For the State : Mr. Praful Jojo, A.P.P.

Heard learned senior counsel appearing for the petitioner
 and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Chatrochatti P.S. Case No. 04 of
2023 corresponding to G.R. No. 402 of 2023, registered for the alleged offence under Sections 376,
354-D, 341, 448, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of learned Judicial
Magistrate, 1st Class, Bermo at Tenughat.
3.  Learned senior counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner and the informant both are gotiyas.
He submits that first incident is said to be of January, 2023 and that has occurred during the presence of the husband of the informant.
He further submits that second occurrence is said to be occurred on 02.04.2023 and false allegations are made of establishing the relationship in the day light in the field.

He also submits that the third occurrence took place on 08.04.2023 in the house of the informant and the entire family members were there and in spite of that the petitioner has entered into the house of the informant forcibly.
4. Learned A.P.P. for the State has opposed the prayer on the ground that Section 376 IPC is there in view of that anticipatory bail may kindly be not rejected.

5. Looking into the contents of the FIR, it transpires that the occurrence is said to be taken on three dates and the lady herself called the petitioner and has opened the door and sometimes allowed the petitioner to enter into the house from the backdoor and the lady is a married one, prima facie it Binod Kumar Mahto vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... ... ... on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140549445/
1 appears that the relationship was consensual in nature.

sentences.text: 7. In view of the attending facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, he is directed to surrender before the learned court within three weeks from today and in the event of his surrender / arrest, the petitioner, named above, shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (twenty-five thousand), with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Bermo at Tenughat, in connection with Chatrochatti P.S. Case No. 04 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. No. 402 of 2023, subject to conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Amitesh/-
